Internal Memo — 2026-09-11
Supplier negotiation for UN-rated 20L HDPE drums concluded with a confirmed order for 150 units at $44.00/unit ($6,600 total), free freight to our Chicago, IL 60607 facility, 50% deposit ($3,300) due now with balance due on delivery, shipment on day 40, and an 18-month warranty. We are processing the $3,300 deposit against this confirmation. Open item: seller still owes us the carrier's transit estimate to verify arrival lands near our 45-day target; seller explicitly made this non-blocking to booking. The remaining 50 units (to complete our 200-unit need) remain a separate follow-on request pending the seller's director approval on both availability and whether the $44 price holds — not yet committed. Total spend within approved budget.
